verdict.rationale:
The docs describe multiple documented one-liner install paths (`npx skills add ...`, `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`) and a real runtime probe confirms the `npx -y skills add mattpocock/skills --skill tdd -a claude-code -y --copy` command actually fetches and installs a skill non-interactively into `.claude/skills/tdd/` with valid frontmatter, matching README claims. This directly satisfies the one-command install story with hands-on verification, not just vendor claims.

missing for 10: no independent confirmation that the Claude Code marketplace install path (`claude plugins install`) was actually run end-to-end, and no explicit evidence the skill is invoked/active by the agent in a live next session beyond the file being present.
